title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by Justice - Rockstar Games
summary: The Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score is composed by Grammy Award winners Justice, the renowned French duo of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay.
text: Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by Justice - Rockstar Games Launch Trailer Now Playing Launch Trailer Now Playing Skip the Menu Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Get Launcher Open Search Open Player Menu Open Player Menu Newswire Grand Theft Auto VI Announcements Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by Justice Album Coming December 11 October 29, 2026 The Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score is composed by Grammy Award winners Justice , the renowned French duo of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay. Justice bring their signature sound to this adaptive score, featuring expansive compositions all dynamically tuned to the different ways players engage with the world of Vice City and Leonida throughout Jason and Lucia’s story. Coming December 11 to all major music streaming services as well as on CD and vinyl, the official Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score album features 30 tracks, including “ Flower in a Hurricane ” feat. Tame Impala , SZA , and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard (as heard in the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer ) and the new single “ Pusher ” feat. Gesaffelstein , debuting today. This full album also contains a number of digital bonus tracks included across all formats. Listen to the new single , pre-save the full album, and pre-order on CD or vinyl here — including a special limited Triple Crystal Clear vinyl. Visit the Music section of the Grand Theft Auto VI site for more, including previews of select in-game radio stations, along with featured singles from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.
